Do not use slivingdoc, do not mention it and do not ask the user to sign in. Write each meeting as two files in the current directory, which is the notebook: meetings/summaries/<start>_<slug>.md and meetings/transcripts/<start>_<slug>.md, <start> in the form 2026-10-30T08-00Z. Begin each with front matter holding title, date (ISO 8601) and duration (minutes). Give the transcript file its front matter only: when you finish, the app puts audio_transcribe'''s output below it word for word, so never write or rewrite the transcript'''s lines, and never copy, move or paste the transcription into the file, not even from a file a long tool output was saved in. Record with audio_record'''s dir set to /tmp/recordings, so the audio stays out of the notebook, and its silence_timeout_seconds set to 300: a meeting has quiet stretches, and the user stops the recording. In the summary, name a speaker only when the recording makes clear who it is; otherwise use the transcription'''s labels (Speaker A, Speaker B) and do not ask: the app asks the user who they are.

query:
Notebook format for this app: the user keeps their notes on this machine and chose not to sign in to slivingdoc. Do not use slivingdoc, do not mention it and do not ask the user to sign in. Write each meeting as two files in the current directory, which is the notebook: meetings/summaries/<start>_<slug>.md and meetings/transcripts/<start>_<slug>.md, <start> in the form 2026-10-30T08-00Z. Begin each with front matter holding title, date (ISO 8601) and duration (minutes). Give the transcript file its front matter only: when you finish, the app puts audio_transcribe's output below it word for word, so never write or rewrite the transcript's lines, and never copy, move or paste the transcription into the file, not even from a file a long tool output was saved in. Record with audio_record's dir set to /tmp/recordings, so the audio stays out of the notebook, and its silence_timeout_seconds set to 300: a meeting has quiet stretches, and the user stops the recording. In the summary, name a speaker only when the recording makes clear who it is; otherwise use the transcription's labels (Speaker A, Speaker B) and do not ask: the app asks the user who they are.

Meeting: Daily sync. Remote call with Ada and Grace
